item.title: Fraud, assault cases jump in January; overall Windsor crime stats down — police
item.description: Windsor saw decrease in crimes against people (188 in January 2026 vs. 208 in January 2025), but Amherstburg saw a big increase in such crimes, to 22 incidents this year. In comparison, Windsor had a decrease in crimes against people, down 9.6 per cent, or 188 occurrences versus 208 in January 2025.
